Complete Guide to Lorem Ipsum Generator

Graphic designers, frontend developers, and UI/UX specialists rely on placeholder dummy text to preview page typography, layout balance, and content flow before the final copy is authored. TECHTIS Lorem Ipsum Generator provides instant, authentic Latin filler text customized to your exact requirements.

You can choose to generate by paragraph, sentence, individual word count, or formatted HTML list items. An optional toggle wraps paragraphs inside valid <p> tags, saving developers time when building HTML templates and design prototypes.

With an uncluttered interface and instant 1-click clipboard copy, you can grab the exact volume of dummy copy you need and stay focused on your design work.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Lorem Ipsum Generator and privacy

Where does Lorem Ipsum originate?
Lorem Ipsum has been the printing industry's standard dummy text since the 1500s, adapted from sections of Cicero's philosophical treatise written in 45 BC.
Why is dummy text preferred over real English text in mockups?
Using Latin placeholder text prevents clients and stakeholders from being distracted by readable words, allowing them to focus entirely on visual hierarchy, typography, and layout balance.
Can I generate HTML markup directly?
Yes! Toggle the HTML Tags option to automatically wrap paragraphs in <p> tags or generate ready-to-use <ul><li> lists.
